scientific limitations/integrity: The result is the exact Fréchet linearization at stationary geodesic spheres. It does not claim an exact nonlinear asymptotic rate. The proof uses standard hypersurface first-variation identities and directly differentiates the source normalization; a finite checker only replays algebraic identities and is not used as an infinite proof.
title: Exact full linearization of a spherical Alexandrov–Fenchel flow
